title: "sequence size exceeds remaining buffer" in ROS 2 Humble with Jazzy or Lyrical nodes: empty node list, Node not found and what still works, measured
excerpt: Humble printed it once per process when Jazzy or Lyrical nodes shared the domain. Topics and service calls still worked, but node list was empty and ros2 param failed both ways. Cyclone DDS changed the errors, not the result, and mixed vendors broke services.
